experiments.scope: Exact sha256-r32-prefix-v1 complete hash of 55-byte single-block messages; digest words H1,H2,H3,H5,H6,H7 computed only by the submitted grouped evaluator (group setup + 856-operation inner body, IV + state after round 30). Per organizer seed: 16 seed-derived 13-word prefixes x u = 0..31 (W13 = u<<8 | 0x80), N_t = 512 = 2^9 messages, 18-bit digest-XOR mask spread over those six words. All 256 trials returned, including failures.
experiments.hypothesis: (1) Every returned pair is a genuine masked match of the trusted sha256-r32 digest, so the grouped evaluator computes the exact digest words. (2) The success frequency of this scaled analogue (N_t^2/2^w = 1 = N^2/2^256) is consistent with the random-function value 1 - prod_{i<512}(1 - i/2^18) = 0.3931 that heuristic H1 assumes at full width. Finite frequencies are supporting evidence, not a certified population probability.

experiments.scope: Same evaluator and target; per organizer seed one seed-derived prefix with consecutive u = 0..511 (all N_t = 512 messages in one group, the most structured case), under a different 18-bit mask on H1,H2,H3,H5,H6,H7. All 256 trials returned, including failures.
experiments.hypothesis: Within-group digests, where only the 24-bit field u of W13 varies by small consecutive values, show no masked-collision excess or deficit relative to the random-function value 0.3931; the grouped structure does not change the birthday behaviour H1 assumes.
